# Your PC, Expanded in XR
Set up your monitors, then work, play, and stay in your space.

—

✅ Works with a Windows PC + PC Host (install from our website) · keep your PC and headset on the same Wi-Fi

⚙️ 3-minute setup → desk.overay.com

—

Connect your Windows PC and bring your setup into XR, where everything stays in front of you and works just like your desktop.



[media]

# 💻 Up to 5 virtual monitors
• Place monitors anywhere with no physical limits




[media]

# 🚀 Quick and easy setup
• Start with ready to use layouts and adjust freely



[media]

# ✨ More than just screens
• Draw, create, and interact while using your PC

• Create a workspace that adapts to your style and workflow

—

# 🔜 Coming soon
• macOS support

New features and experiences arrive with every update.

Discover what’s next in your space.

—

# 💬 Need help?

Running into an issue? Drop by our Discord and our team will help you out 

→ https://discord.com/invite/hgKnEHfwkr
